description: This file implements a platform-independent utility function for creating a Slap Owo Loac object in the SLAP component of the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It defines the function SlapCreateOwoLoac which calls SlapOwoLoacCreate with provided context handles.

methods.name: SlapCreateOwoLoac
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Slap Owo Loac object by calling SlapOwoLoacCreate with context handles.
